# Test-FinalAcceptance.ps1

This is the final fail-closed evidence aggregator for the nine groups in `Requirements/21_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE_ORCHESTRATION.md`: TestLab/real I/O, confirmed reconciliation, Windows privileged capabilities, Windows 10 22H2, idle resource acceptance, MFT performance, physical installer, live Agent/Explorer correlation, and branch integration. Live Agent/Explorer evidence must reference existing executable/oracle/Explorer files and an Agent history directory.

Each group must be a real JSON artifact with its required schema, product-specific fields, `AcceptanceEligible=true`, and a non-diagnostic, non-partial, non-failed status. The TestLab group additionally requires `Status=COMPLETED_REAL_IO_ACCEPTANCE`, `ExecutionMode=TestLab`, `Diagnostic=false`, positive oracle/source/canonical/final-state counts, all-PASS checks, an empty failure list, and an existing history directory. Release-only evidence remains required for privileged, MFT, and formal resource gates.

The validator checks the fixed sixteen-capability Windows 11 x64/elevated contract, populated privileged oracle/source/canonical/state/reconciliation/service payloads, the exact eleven installer case IDs and statuses, a passed Windows 11 VirtualBox installer prerequisite before the Windows 11 physical installer result, connected MFT correctness/count/drop evidence and required portable/MFT suites, dedicated-volume markers, the fixed 600-second physical resource and quiet-witness checks, live correlation with `FalseExactCount=0`, complete durable counts, matching oracle paths, empty failures, and branch state. Windows 10 additionally requires the `Compose-Windows10StageA.ps1` Stage A artifact identifying `SC-Test-W10-VBox`/`VirtualBoxVm`/`VM`, exactly one real passing result for every required Stage A check, an all-PASS physical Windows 10 22H2 x64 preflight, and a real physical installer manifest. Confirmed reconciliation evidence must retain journal boundaries, scan timing, mathematically consistent counters/ratios, privilege and ACL fallback telemetry, low-priority/I/O-hint telemetry, and non-negative counts.

Missing, malformed, `NOT_EXECUTED`, `AcceptanceEligible=false`, diagnostic, fixture-only, or partial artifacts produce `AcceptanceEligible=false` and exit code 2. The final gate performs no VM, disk, installer, branch, or network operation and cannot turn a fixture or diagnostic result into acceptance. Windows privileged product payloads must reference existing oracle/history/evidence paths.
